title: Unique.domains MCP server: domain name data for AI assistants
description:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets an AI assistant answer questions about domain names from a record instead of guessing: 34 million one-word names on 505 endings, nine registrars' price lists and seven auction venues, read every day.

Its tools return a name's status, registry record and DNS, what similar names sold for, what registrars charge for an ending with each confirmed price change, the endings whose renewal costs at least twice their first year, sales and auction totals, naming trends and the industry agenda. An answer carries its day where the record has one. No tool registers, buys or changes a name. You can read the same record yourself: a name at https://unique.domains/whois, the nine price lists at https://unique.domains/registrars.

The server is hosted at https://mcp.unique.domains/mcp, with no sign-in. It also runs on your machine with npx -y @uniquedomains/mcp-server, on Node.js 20 or later. It is in the official MCP Registry as domains.unique/mcp-server. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api/mcp.
